39031.rationale: All ten actual seed-39031 records and all their projected fields were read, including every distribution title/description/format, keyword, publisher and available spatial field; no temporal fields were present. Across the three seeds, each ID retains its exact catalogue model, product, documented process/ledger qualification, column concepts and units. b031/b032 have physical dimensions, reporting month and release identity; b033/b039 have friction and roughness only; b034/b040 have friction only; b035 has unloaded mass/month; b036 has price/carton dimensions only; b037/b038 have friction, roughness and water depth. Missing water depth or roughness was not inferred from the testing topic; excluded sensors and absent water were not counted as measured variables. Every record has CSV and PDF whose descriptions explicitly associate the same listed columns with comma-separated tables and PDF tables respectively. Extra distributions: b034 CSV, b035 PDF, b039 PDF, b040 CSV; these repeat the same local column facts, not new contexts. Verification is of supplied metadata association, not downloaded file bytes. No whole records are identical, no answer keys/grade codes/intent tags or no-answer conjunctions appear in the actual fields. Titles and prose are noticeably templated, but titles are not bare category labels and descriptions supply subject, protocol and catalogue identity. Meaningful wording variation exists in sentence ordering, paragraph structure, basis phrasing and whether columns are in description or only distributions; filler remains repetitive. Strict all-facts-preserved is unresolved: numerical examples and study/publisher attribution change, not just wording. Seed-39031 numerical examples (dimensions for b031/b032; friction/roughness/depth where present) are b031 63.59, b032 77.05, b033 0.85/0.52, b034 0.56, b035 mass 1179.69, b036 price 128.51/carton 133 x 90 x 65, b037 0.43/1.14/1.62, b038 0.41/1.74/1.62, b039 0.56/0.75, b040 0.63. These literal values are evidenced in the corresponding record facts and differ from other seeds. Since they are labelled e.g., they need not be contradictory measurements of identical samples, but exact factual invariance cannot be certified. Also unresolved in every seed: b036 is commercial observational content, so the experimental-basis dichotomy cannot faithfully encode it. No query texts or other corpus packets were supplied/read; paraphrase equivalence, full-corpus coverage and external authoritative identity cannot be independently certified from this packet. Identity observations refer only to explicit catalogue assertions in the actual descriptions, not row keys or semantically similar components.
